meta.name: mongodb
meta.description: Query and manage MongoDB databases via Atlas Data API (curl) or mongosh. Connect to MongoDB Atlas collections without installing heavy CLI tools.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 直接操作 NoSQL 数据库集合,免装重型客户端
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要查 MongoDB 数据却不想装本地客户端
copy.tagline_en: Query and manage NoSQL collections without heavy installs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with MongoDB data but avoid installing heavy clients

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可连接 MongoDB,查询和管理数据,如查找、插入、更新文档,并返回结果。无需安装额外命令行工具。
howto.when: 当用户提出查询、插入或更新等 MongoDB 数据操作需求时触发。

say.text: 向 orders 集合插入一条新订单,金额 100 元。
say.note: 将在数据库中新增该记录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can connect to MongoDB and query/manage data, e.g., find, insert, update documents, returning results, without needing extra CLI tools.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to query, insert, or update data in MongoDB.

say_en.text: Find all active users in the users collection and return the first 10.
say_en.note: Executes a find and returns the user list.

say_en.text: Insert a new order into the orders collection with amount 100.
say_en.note: Adds a new record to the database.

say_en.text: Update the status field of user john@example.com to inactive.
say_en.note: The user's status will be updated.
